skills.name: visitor-intake
skills.description: Guided intake for a visitor or a referring agent - who they are, what they need, who would help, and what stays private - captured as a consent-scoped brief; nothing is shared beyond the fields the person marks shareable.

skills.name: verified-record-answers
skills.description: Answers about E5's programs and the Free Karmelo case drawn only from E5's verified record; facts outside the record are declined plainly, never improvised.

skills.name: consent-based-introductions
skills.description: Double-opt-in introductions between people and organizations whose stated needs and offers complement each other; a pass is final and is never re-proposed.

skills.name: agent-to-agent-contact
skills.description: Structured agent contact under E5's broker protocol v0 (HELLO, BRIEF, NEED, OFFER, PROPOSE-INTRO, RESPOND, ATTEST); the live transport today is signed structured email - see x-e5-contact.
